data.summary:
Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of progressive experience across P&C Insurance, Banking & Payments, and Finance & Treasury domains.
Deep expertise in SWIFT messaging standards (MT103, MT202, MT940, MT950, MX/ISO 20022), Vostro & Nostro account management, correspondent banking, payment lifecycle management, and treasury operations.
Proven track record in P&C Insurance (Policy Administration, Claims Management, Billing, Underwriting), digital transformation, and AI-powered workflow automation.
Strong experience in requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, Agile/Scrum delivery, stakeholder management, and UAT execution.
Adept at translating complex business processes into precise technical specifications that deliver measurable ROI.
Familiar with core banking platforms (Finacle, T24/Temenos, FIS), insurance policy systems, and CRM platforms (Zendesk).
Certified SAFe Agilist (in progress) and CBAP (pursuing).
Key Domains: P&C Insurance (Policy, Claims, Billing, Underwriting)  •  SWIFT/MT/MX Payments  •  ISO 20022 / SEPA / RTGS  •  Nostro/Vostro/Correspondent Banking  •  Treasury & Cash Management  •  Trade Finance  •  HRMS  •  E-Commerce

responsibilities: Leading business analysis, Target Operating Model (TOM) design and requirements engineering across banking, payments and insurance transformation initiatives, defining current-state processes, future-state operating models, business capabilities and transformation opportunities across cross-functional teams.

Elicited and documented end-to-end insurance business requirements across policy lifecycle: new business, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements, maintaining 100% requirement traceability via RTM
Defined functional requirements for automated claims workflows: FNOL intake, claim assignment, investigation, adjudication, settlement, and payment disbursement, reducing manual intervention by 40%
Specified billing center automation requirements covering premium calculation, invoice generation, payment processing, and delinquency management workflows
Documented multi-level underwriting approval workflows with automated routing rules based on policy amount, risk score, transaction type, and business rules engine configuration
Performed AS-IS/TO-BE gap analysis identifying $11M ROI opportunity through intelligent workflow optimization and process reengineering across insurance operations
Gathered and documented business requirements for Investment Banking and Capital Markets applications supporting Office operations.
Analyzed the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture, execution, allocation, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation.
Collaborated with traders, portfolio managers, operations, risk, finance, and compliance teams to translate business needs into functional requirements.
Created BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and RTMs for Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Derivatives trading platforms.

Defined Target Operating Models (TOMs) for Investment Banking and Capital Markets processes by assessing current operating structures, identifying process, people, data and technology gaps, and designing future-state operating models aligned with business objectives.

Developed business capability maps across Trade Processing, Settlement, Reconciliation, Risk, Finance and Operations to identify capability gaps, ownership dependencies and opportunities for process transformation.

Created end-to-end customer/user journey maps for banking and investment workflows, mapping key touchpoints, business interactions, hand-offs, pain points and exception scenarios to identify opportunities for improved service delivery and operational efficiency.
Supported UAT by preparing test scenarios, validating trade workflows, coordinating defect resolution, and obtaining business sign-off.
Worked with regulatory teams to align solutions with Basel III, AML/KYC requirements.
Documented business rules for trade validation, exception handling, corporate actions, and securities settlement.
Worked on portfolio management, position management, cash reconciliation, P&L reporting, and exposure monitoring requirements.
Gathered and documented business requirements for payment gateway integrations including SWIFT MT/MX messaging standards, payment authorization flows, and settlement processing pipelines

Defined functional specifications for cross-border payment workflows covering SWIFT MT103 (customer transfers), MT202 (bank transfers), MT940/950 (account statement/balance reporting), and ISO 20022 MX message formats
Documented Nostro/Vostro account reconciliation processes, correspondent banking workflows, and automated matching rules for payment exception handling and dispute resolution
Specified integration requirements between policy administration/claims platforms and payment gateways, banking APIs, and settlement systems for premium collection and claims disbursement
Collaborated with development and integration teams to define API contracts for payment gateway connectivity, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS, banking regulations, and SWIFT network standards

Designed Target Operating Models for cross-border payment processes, defining future-state processes, roles and responsibilities, operational controls, system interactions and governance across payment initiation, processing, settlement and reconciliation.

Mapped end-to-end payment customer journeys covering payment initiation, beneficiary validation, authorization, screening, routing, processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception/repair handling, identifying customer and operational pain points.

Developed business capability maps for Payments, covering payment initiation, payment processing, sanctions/compliance, clearing & settlement, reconciliation, investigation and reporting capabilities, and assessed gaps between current and target-state capabilities.
Performed TOM and capability gap assessments to identify opportunities for payment process standardization, automation, straight-through processing and improved operational controls.
Defined requirements for ML-powered intelligent routing engine: predictive claim routing, fraud detection patterns, automated underwriting decisioning, and payment anomaly detection capabilities
Specified acceptance criteria for AI/ML models including accuracy thresholds, performance benchmarks, data governance requirements, and regulatory explainability standards
Supported CRM workflow improvements via Zendesk: ticket routing automation, SLA tracking configuration, and integration specifications with insurance/banking platforms
Served as primary liaison across business stakeholders, product owners, dev teams, QA, and C-level executives; facilitated JAD sessions, design reviews, UAT, and sprint ceremonies
Managed 100+ user story backlog aligned to business objectives; achieved 95%+ sprint commitment accuracy through refined estimation, capacity planning, and story clarity
Reduced sprint spillover by 30% and improved velocity by 18% within first quarter through impediment removal, workflow optimization, and requirement standardization
Delivered 5 major releases with 98% pre-production defect identification rate; accelerated time-to-market by 3 weeks through zero-rework requirements delivery
Led business analysis and Agile delivery for insurance, banking, and enterprise application product development teams across multiple concurrent Scrum teams.

Analyzed and documented complex P&C insurance business processes across policy management, commercial lines underwriting, billing operations, and claims workflows; delivered 22% improvement in operational efficiency
Performed SWOT analysis, cost-benefit analysis, and risk assessments to evaluate solution alternatives for insurance process automation and digital transformation initiatives
Created comprehensive AS-IS/TO-BE documentation, swimlane diagrams, data flow diagrams, and ERDs for policy, billing, and claims systems; maintained RTM ensuring full bidirectional traceability
Gathered and documented requirements for payment processing workflows: transaction validation, authorization, payment reconciliation, settlement, and end-of-day reporting processes
Defined business rules for SWIFT-based payment flows, wire transfer processing, and exception handling scenarios for cross-border and domestic payment operations
Developed detailed specifications for banking transaction workflows including payment status tracking, reconciliation gap analysis, and operational KPI dashboards using Power BI and Excel
Documented integration requirements for CRM platforms (Zendesk) with banking/payment systems to support customer payment inquiries, dispute handling, and transaction status tracking
Collaborated with technology teams on API integration specifications for payment gateways, banking systems, and third-party financial data providers ensuring data accuracy and compliance
Facilitated Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions across 3 concurrent Scrum teams
Increased team velocity by 22% over 6 months through process optimization, requirement clarity, and Agile coaching (Planning Poker, T-Shirt Sizing, capacity planning)
Successfully transitioned 2 teams from Waterfall to Agile methodology with zero disruption to delivery; delivered 8 major product releases on schedule and within budget
Achieved 90%+ stakeholder satisfaction scores through proactive communication, timely delivery, and high-quality documentation standards
Drove requirements engineering and business analysis for insurance and HRMS product development initiatives, delivering high-quality documentation with zero post-development change requests.
Created BRDs, FRDs, SRS documents, process flow diagrams, swimlane diagrams, use case diagrams, and functional specifications for P&C insurance and HRMS modules
Developed AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, gap analysis, feasibility studies, root cause analysis, and impact assessments for feature requests and enhancement initiatives
Supported UAT planning and execution: test case development, defect management, sign-off coordination; reduced requirement gathering cycle by 25% via standardized templates
Collaborated with QA and development teams ensuring requirement clarity, testability, and comprehensive acceptance criteria; maintained full RTM from elicitation through deployment
Supported BFSI domain requirements across payment processing, transaction workflows, and insurance operations.
Worked on BFSI payment processing requirements: transaction validation, payment reconciliation, settlement workflows, refund processing, and dispute management business rules
Gathered and documented banking transaction flow requirements including payment authorization, payment status tracking, exception handling, and chargeback/dispute processes
Defined integration requirements between CRM platforms and banking/payment systems for customer payment inquiry handling and dispute resolution workflows
Created process documentation for end-to-end payment lifecycle: initiation → authorization → clearing → settlement → reporting; designed Power BI dashboards for payment KPI monitoring
Analyzed financial transaction data to identify payment failures, reconciliation gaps, and process improvement opportunities; reduced documentation rework by 20%
Delivered requirements for 3 major product releases on schedule; translated business needs into user stories with precise acceptance criteria for Agile development teams
Assisted senior BAs in requirements gathering, documentation, validation, UAT coordination, and defect management for insurance and BFSI product development projects
Prepared process maps, user flows, wireframes, and supporting documentation; reduced documentation cycle time by 20% through template standardization
Conducted industry and competitive research to support decision-making; recognized for attention to detail, analytical skills, and proactive stakeholder communication
Coordinated schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocation across development, QA, and operations for 5+ concurrent projects ensuring on-time delivery
Maintained project documentation, tracked risks/issues/dependencies, and produced weekly status reports and monthly dashboards for senior stakeholders

targets.text: JITENDRA SAGAR
SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST
P&C Insurance  |  Banking & Payments (SWIFT/ISO 20022) | BFSI
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of progressive experience across P&C Insurance, Banking & Payments, and Finance & Treasury domains. Deep expertise in SWIFT messaging standards (MT103, MT202, MT940, MT950, MX/ISO 20022), Vostro & Nostro account management, correspondent banking, payment lifecycle management, and treasury operations. Proven track record in P&C Insurance (Policy Administration, Claims Management, Billing, Underwriting), digital transformation, and AI-powered workflow automation. Strong experience in requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, Agile/Scrum delivery, stakeholder management, and UAT execution. Adept at translating complex business processes into precise technical specifications that deliver measurable ROI. Familiar with core banking platforms (Finacle, T24/Temenos, FIS), insurance policy systems, and CRM platforms (Zendesk). Certified SAFe Agilist (
in progress) and CBAP (pursuing).

Key Domains: P&C Insurance (Policy, Claims, Billing, Underwriting)  •  SWIFT/MT/MX Payments  •  ISO 20022 / SEPA / RTGS  •  Nostro/Vostro/Correspondent Banking  •  Treasury & Cash Management  •  Trade Finance  •  HRMS  •  E-Commerce

BA & PM Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Visio, Lucidchart, Draw.io, Miro, Smartsheet, Trello, Asana, MS Project

Data & Analytics: SQL, Power BI, Excel
Insurance Systems: Policy Administration Systems, Claims Management Platforms, Billing Systems
Collaboration: Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Zendesk (CRM)
Finance & ERP: SAP (Basic), Oracle Financials (Basic), Treasury Management Systems (TMS)
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner
EA Team (Client – Standard Chartered ( US ) 					January 2024 – Present

Leading business analysis, Target Operating Model (TOM) design and requirements engineering across banking, payments and insurance transformation initiatives, defining current-state processes, future-state operating models, business capabilities and transformation opportunities across cross-functional teams.
P&C Insurance – Policy, Claims, Billing & Underwriting

Elicited and documented end-to-end insurance business requirements across policy lifecycle: new business, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements, maintaining 100% requirement traceability via RTM
Defined functional requirements for automated claims workflows: FNOL intake, claim assignment, investigation, adjudication, settlement, and payment disbursement, reducing manual intervention by 40%
Specified billing center automation requirements covering premium calculation, invoice generation, payment processing, and delinquency management workflows
Documented multi-level underwriting approval workflows with automated routing rules based on policy amount, risk score, transaction type, and business rules engine configuration
Performed AS-IS/TO-BE gap analysis identifying $11M ROI opportunity through intelligent workflow optimization and process reengineering across insurance operations
Capital Markets / Investment Banking
Gathered and documented business requirements for Investment Banking and Capital Markets applications supporting Office operations.
Analyzed the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture, execution, allocation, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation.
Collaborated with traders, portfolio managers, operations, risk, finance, and compliance teams to translate business needs into functional requirements.
Created BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and RTMs for Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Derivatives trading platforms.

Defined Target Operating Models (TOMs) for Investment Banking and Capital Markets processes by assessing current operating structures, identifying process, people, data and technology gaps, and designing future-state operating models aligned with business objectives.

Developed business capability maps across Trade Processing, Settlement, Reconciliation, Risk, Finance and Operations to identify capability gaps, ownership dependencies and opportunities for process transformation.

Created end-to-end customer/user journey maps for banking and investment workflows, mapping key touchpoints, business interactions, hand-offs, pain points and exception scenarios to identify opportunities for improved service delivery and operational efficiency.
Supported UAT by preparing test scenarios, validating trade workflows, coordinating defect resolution, and obtaining business sign-off.
Worked with regulatory teams to align solutions with Basel III, AML/KYC requirements.
Documented business rules for trade validation, exception handling, corporate actions, and securities settlement.
Worked on portfolio management, position management, cash reconciliation, P&L reporting, and exposure monitoring requirements.
Banking, Payments & SWIFT Integration
Gathered and documented business requirements for payment gateway integrations including SWIFT MT/MX messaging standards, payment authorization flows, and settlement processing pipelines

Defined functional specifications for cross-border payment workflows covering SWIFT MT103 (customer transfers), MT202 (bank transfers), MT940/950 (account statement/balance reporting), and ISO 20022 MX message formats
Documented Nostro/Vostro account reconciliation processes, correspondent banking workflows, and automated matching rules for payment exception handling and dispute resolution
Specified integration requirements between policy administration/claims platforms and payment gateways, banking APIs, and settlement systems for premium collection and claims disbursement
Collaborated with development and integration teams to define API contracts for payment gateway connectivity, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS, banking regulations, and SWIFT network standards

Designed Target Operating Models for cross-border payment processes, defining future-state processes, roles and responsibilities, operational controls, system interactions and governance across payment initiation, processing, settlement and reconciliation.

Mapped end-to-end payment customer journeys covering payment initiation, beneficiary validation, authorization, screening, routing, processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception/repair handling, identifying customer and operational pain points.

Developed business capability maps for Payments, covering payment initiation, payment processing, sanctions/compliance, clearing & settlement, reconciliation, investigation and reporting capabilities, and assessed gaps between current and target-state capabilities.
Performed TOM and capability gap assessments to identify opportunities for payment process standardization, automation, straight-through processing and improved operational controls.
AI, Automation & Digital Transformation
Defined requirements for ML-powered intelligent routing engine: predictive claim routing, fraud detection patterns, automated underwriting decisioning, and payment anomaly detection capabilities
Specified acceptance criteria for AI/ML models including accuracy thresholds, performance benchmarks, data governance requirements, and regulatory explainability standards
Supported CRM workflow improvements via Zendesk: ticket routing automation, SLA tracking configuration, and integration specifications with insurance/banking platforms
Stakeholder Management & Agile Delivery
Served as primary liaison across business stakeholders, product owners, dev teams, QA, and C-level executives; facilitated JAD sessions, design reviews, UAT, and sprint ceremonies
Managed 100+ user story backlog aligned to business objectives; achieved 95%+ sprint commitment accuracy through refined estimation, capacity planning, and story clarity
Reduced sprint spillover by 30% and improved velocity by 18% within first quarter through impediment removal, workflow optimization, and requirement standardization
Delivered 5 major releases with 98% pre-production defect identification rate; accelerated time-to-market by 3 weeks through zero-rework requirements delivery
Senior Business Analyst | IDC Technology (Clients – Allstate, Global Alliance Corporation (GAL))
May 2021 – December 2023
Led business analysis and Agile delivery for insurance, banking, and enterprise application product development teams across multiple concurrent Scrum teams.
Insurance Domain Analysis

Analyzed and documented complex P&C insurance business processes across policy management, commercial lines underwriting, billing operations, and claims workflows; delivered 22% improvement in operational efficiency
Performed SWOT analysis, cost-benefit analysis, and risk assessments to evaluate solution alternatives for insurance process automation and digital transformation initiatives
Created comprehensive AS-IS/TO-BE documentation, swimlane diagrams, data flow diagrams, and ERDs for policy, billing, and claims systems; maintained RTM ensuring full bidirectional traceability
Banking, Payments & Financial Domain
Gathered and documented requirements for payment processing workflows: transaction validation, authorization, payment reconciliation, settlement, and end-of-day reporting processes
Defined business rules for SWIFT-based payment flows, wire transfer processing, and exception handling scenarios for cross-border and domestic payment operations
Developed detailed specifications for banking transaction workflows including payment status tracking, reconciliation gap analysis, and operational KPI dashboards using Power BI and Excel
Documented integration requirements for CRM platforms (Zendesk) with banking/payment systems to support customer payment inquiries, dispute handling, and transaction status tracking
Collaborated with technology teams on API integration specifications for payment gateways, banking systems, and third-party financial data providers ensuring data accuracy and compliance
Agile Delivery & Team Leadership
Facilitated Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions across 3 concurrent Scrum teams
Increased team velocity by 22% over 6 months through process optimization, requirement clarity, and Agile coaching (Planning Poker, T-Shirt Sizing, capacity planning)
Successfully transitioned 2 teams from Waterfall to Agile methodology with zero disruption to delivery; delivered 8 major product releases on schedule and within budget
Achieved 90%+ stakeholder satisfaction scores through proactive communication, timely delivery, and high-quality documentation standards

targets.text: Business Analyst | IDC Technology	August 2020 – April 2021
Drove requirements engineering and business analysis for insurance and HRMS product development initiatives, delivering high-quality documentation with zero post-development change requests.
Created BRDs, FRDs, SRS documents, process flow diagrams, swimlane diagrams, use case diagrams, and functional specifications for P&C insurance and HRMS modules
Developed AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, gap analysis, feasibility studies, root cause analysis, and impact assessments for feature requests and enhancement initiatives
Supported UAT planning and execution: test case development, defect management, sign-off coordination; reduced requirement gathering cycle by 25% via standardized templates
Collaborated with QA and development teams ensuring requirement clarity, testability, and comprehensive acceptance criteria; maintained full RTM from elicitation through deployment
Business Analyst | IDC Technology	July 2019 – July 2020
Supported BFSI domain requirements across payment processing, transaction workflows, and insurance operations.
Worked on BFSI payment processing requirements: transaction validation, payment reconciliation, settlement workflows, refund processing, and dispute management business rules
Gathered and documented banking transaction flow requirements including payment authorization, payment status tracking, exception handling, and chargeback/dispute processes
Defined integration requirements between CRM platforms and banking/payment systems for customer payment inquiry handling and dispute resolution workflows
Created process documentation for end-to-end payment lifecycle: initiation → authorization → clearing → settlement → reporting; designed Power BI dashboards for payment KPI monitoring
Analyzed financial transaction data to identify payment failures, reconciliation gaps, and process improvement opportunities; reduced documentation rework by 20%
Delivered requirements for 3 major product releases on schedule; translated business needs into user stories with precise acceptance criteria for Agile development teams
Associate Business Analyst | IDC Technology	July 2018 – May 2019
Assisted senior BAs in requirements gathering, documentation, validation, UAT coordination, and defect management for insurance and BFSI product development projects
Prepared process maps, user flows, wireframes, and supporting documentation; reduced documentation cycle time by 20% through template standardization
Conducted industry and competitive research to support decision-making; recognized for attention to detail, analytical skills, and proactive stakeholder communication
Project Coordinator | IDC Technology	April 2017 – July 2018
Coordinated schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocation across development, QA, and operations for 5+ concurrent projects ensuring on-time delivery
Maintained project documentation, tracked risks/issues/dependencies, and produced weekly status reports and monthly dashboards for senior stakeholders

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of progressive experience across P&C Insurance, Banking & Payments, and Finance & Treasury domains. Deep expertise in SWIFT messaging standards (MT103, MT202, MT940, MT950, MX/ISO 20022), Vostro & Nostro account management, correspondent banking, payment lifecycle management, and treasury operations. Proven track record in P&C Insurance (Policy Administration, Claims Management, Billing, Underwriting), digital transformation, and AI-powered workflow automation. Strong experience in requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, Agile/Scrum delivery, stakeholder management, and UAT execution. Adept at translating complex business processes into precise technical specifications that deliver measurable ROI. Familiar with core banking platforms (Finacle, T24/Temenos, FIS), insurance policy systems, and CRM platforms (Zendesk). Certified SAFe Agilist (in progress) and CBAP (pursuing).
Key Domains: P&C Insurance (Policy, Claims, Billing, Underwriting)  •  SWIFT/MT/MX Payments  •  ISO 20022 / SEPA / RTGS  •  Nostro/Vostro/Correspondent Banking  •  Treasury & Cash Management  •  Trade Finance  •  HRMS  •  E-Commerce

sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner  
EA Team (Client – Standard Chartered ( US ) 					January 2024 – Present
Leading business analysis, Target Operating Model (TOM) design and requirements engineering across banking, payments and insurance transformation initiatives, defining current-state processes, future-state operating models, business capabilities and transformation opportunities across cross-functional teams.
P&C Insurance – Policy, Claims, Billing & Underwriting
Elicited and documented end-to-end insurance business requirements across policy lifecycle: new business, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements, maintaining 100% requirement traceability via RTM
Defined functional requirements for automated claims workflows: FNOL intake, claim assignment, investigation, adjudication, settlement, and payment disbursement, reducing manual intervention by 40%
Specified billing center automation requirements covering premium calculation, invoice generation, payment processing, and delinquency management workflows
Documented multi-level underwriting approval workflows with automated routing rules based on policy amount, risk score, transaction type, and business rules engine configuration
Performed AS-IS/TO-BE gap analysis identifying $11M ROI opportunity through intelligent workflow optimization and process reengineering across insurance operations
Capital Markets / Investment Banking
Gathered and documented business requirements for Investment Banking and Capital Markets applications supporting Office operations.
Analyzed the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture, execution, allocation, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation.
Collaborated with traders, portfolio managers, operations, risk, finance, and compliance teams to translate business needs into functional requirements.
Created BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and RTMs for Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Derivatives trading platforms.
Defined Target Operating Models (TOMs) for Investment Banking and Capital Markets processes by assessing current operating structures, identifying process, people, data and technology gaps, and designing future-state operating models aligned with business objectives.
Developed business capability maps across Trade Processing, Settlement, Reconciliation, Risk, Finance and Operations to identify capability gaps, ownership dependencies and opportunities for process transformation.
Created end-to-end customer/user journey maps for banking and investment workflows, mapping key touchpoints, business interactions, hand-offs, pain points and exception scenarios to identify opportunities for improved service delivery and operational efficiency.
Supported UAT by preparing test scenarios, validating trade workflows, coordinating defect resolution, and obtaining business sign-off.
Worked with regulatory teams to align solutions with Basel III, AML/KYC requirements.
Documented business rules for trade validation, exception handling, corporate actions, and securities settlement.
Worked on portfolio management, position management, cash reconciliation, P&L reporting, and exposure monitoring requirements.
Banking, Payments & SWIFT Integration
Gathered and documented business requirements for payment gateway integrations including SWIFT MT/MX messaging standards, payment authorization flows, and settlement processing pipelines
Defined functional specifications for cross-border payment workflows covering SWIFT MT103 (customer transfers), MT202 (bank transfers), MT940/950 (account statement/balance reporting), and ISO 20022 MX message formats
Documented Nostro/Vostro account reconciliation processes, correspondent banking workflows, and automated matching rules for payment exception handling and dispute resolution
Specified integration requirements between policy administration/claims platforms and payment gateways, banking APIs, and settlement systems for premium collection and claims disbursement
Collaborated with development and integration teams to define API contracts for payment gateway connectivity, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS, banking regulations, and SWIFT network standards
Designed Target Operating Models for cross-border payment processes, defining future-state processes, roles and responsibilities, operational controls, system interactions and governance across payment initiation, processing, settlement and reconciliation.
Mapped end-to-end payment customer journeys covering payment initiation, beneficiary validation, authorization, screening, routing, processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception/repair handling, identifying customer and operational pain points.
Developed business capability maps for Payments, covering payment initiation, payment processing, sanctions/compliance, clearing & settlement, reconciliation, investigation and reporting capabilities, and assessed gaps between current and target-state capabilities.
Performed TOM and capability gap assessments to identify opportunities for payment process standardization, automation, straight-through processing and improved operational controls.
AI, Automation & Digital Transformation
Defined requirements for ML-powered intelligent routing engine: predictive claim routing, fraud detection patterns, automated underwriting decisioning, and payment anomaly detection capabilities
Specified acceptance criteria for AI/ML models including accuracy thresholds, performance benchmarks, data governance requirements, and regulatory explainability standards
Supported CRM workflow improvements via Zendesk: ticket routing automation, SLA tracking configuration, and integration specifications with insurance/banking platforms
Stakeholder Management & Agile Delivery
Served as primary liaison across business stakeholders, product owners, dev teams, QA, and C-level executives; facilitated JAD sessions, design reviews, UAT, and sprint ceremonies
Managed 100+ user story backlog aligned to business objectives; achieved 95%+ sprint commitment accuracy through refined estimation, capacity planning, and story clarity
Reduced sprint spillover by 30% and improved velocity by 18% within first quarter through impediment removal, workflow optimization, and requirement standardization
Delivered 5 major releases with 98% pre-production defect identification rate; accelerated time-to-market by 3 weeks through zero-rework requirements delivery
Senior Business Analyst | IDC Technology (Clients – Allstate, Global Alliance Corporation (GAL))
May 2021 – December 2023
Led business analysis and Agile delivery for insurance, banking, and enterprise application product development teams across multiple concurrent Scrum teams.
Insurance Domain Analysis
Analyzed and documented complex P&C insurance business processes across policy management, commercial lines underwriting, billing operations, and claims workflows; delivered 22% improvement in operational efficiency
Performed SWOT analysis, cost-benefit analysis, and risk assessments to evaluate solution alternatives for insurance process automation and digital transformation initiatives
Created comprehensive AS-IS/TO-BE documentation, swimlane diagrams, data flow diagrams, and ERDs for policy, billing, and claims systems; maintained RTM ensuring full bidirectional traceability
Banking, Payments & Financial Domain
Gathered and documented requirements for payment processing workflows: transaction validation, authorization, payment reconciliation, settlement, and end-of-day reporting processes
Defined business rules for SWIFT-based payment flows, wire transfer processing, and exception handling scenarios for cross-border and domestic payment operations
Developed detailed specifications for banking transaction workflows including payment status tracking, reconciliation gap analysis, and operational KPI dashboards using Power BI and Excel
Documented integration requirements for CRM platforms (Zendesk) with banking/payment systems to support customer payment inquiries, dispute handling, and transaction status tracking
Collaborated with technology teams on API integration specifications for payment gateways, banking systems, and third-party financial data providers ensuring data accuracy and compliance
Agile Delivery & Team Leadership
Facilitated Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions across 3 concurrent Scrum teams
Increased team velocity by 22% over 6 months through process optimization, requirement clarity, and Agile coaching (Planning Poker, T-Shirt Sizing, capacity planning)
Successfully transitioned 2 teams from Waterfall to Agile methodology with zero disruption to delivery; delivered 8 major product releases on schedule and within budget
Achieved 90%+ stakeholder satisfaction scores through proactive communication, timely delivery, and high-quality documentation standards
Business Analyst | IDC Technology	August 2020 – April 2021
Drove requirements engineering and business analysis for insurance and HRMS product development initiatives, delivering high-quality documentation with zero post-development change requests.
Created BRDs, FRDs, SRS documents, process flow diagrams, swimlane diagrams, use case diagrams, and functional specifications for P&C insurance and HRMS modules
Developed AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, gap analysis, feasibility studies, root cause analysis, and impact assessments for feature requests and enhancement initiatives
Supported UAT planning and execution: test case development, defect management, sign-off coordination; reduced requirement gathering cycle by 25% via standardized templates
Collaborated with QA and development teams ensuring requirement clarity, testability, and comprehensive acceptance criteria; maintained full RTM from elicitation through deployment
Business Analyst | IDC Technology	July 2019 – July 2020
Supported BFSI domain requirements across payment processing, transaction workflows, and insurance operations.
Worked on BFSI payment processing requirements: transaction validation, payment reconciliation, settlement workflows, refund processing, and dispute management business rules
Gathered and documented banking transaction flow requirements including payment authorization, payment status tracking, exception handling, and chargeback/dispute processes
Defined integration requirements between CRM platforms and banking/payment systems for customer payment inquiry handling and dispute resolution workflows
Created process documentation for end-to-end payment lifecycle: initiation → authorization → clearing → settlement → reporting; designed Power BI dashboards for payment KPI monitoring
Analyzed financial transaction data to identify payment failures, reconciliation gaps, and process improvement opportunities; reduced documentation rework by 20%
Delivered requirements for 3 major product releases on schedule; translated business needs into user stories with precise acceptance criteria for Agile development teams
Associate Business Analyst | IDC Technology	July 2018 – May 2019
Assisted senior BAs in requirements gathering, documentation, validation, UAT coordination, and defect management for insurance and BFSI product development projects
Prepared process maps, user flows, wireframes, and supporting documentation; reduced documentation cycle time by 20% through template standardization
Conducted industry and competitive research to support decision-making; recognized for attention to detail, analytical skills, and proactive stakeholder communication
Project Coordinator | IDC Technology	April 2017 – July 2018
Coordinated schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocation across development, QA, and operations for 5+ concurrent projects ensuring on-time delivery
Maintained project documentation, tracked risks/issues/dependencies, and produced weekly status reports and monthly dashboards for senior stakeholders

logical_blocks.text:
Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner  
EA Team (Client – Standard Chartered ( US ) 					January 2024 – Present
Leading business analysis, Target Operating Model (TOM) design and requirements engineering across banking, payments and insurance transformation initiatives, defining current-state processes, future-state operating models, business capabilities and transformation opportunities across cross-functional teams.
P&C Insurance – Policy, Claims, Billing & Underwriting
Elicited and documented end-to-end insurance business requirements across policy lifecycle: new business, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements, maintaining 100% requirement traceability via RTM
Defined functional requirements for automated claims workflows: FNOL intake, claim assignment, investigation, adjudication, settlement, and payment disbursement, reducing manual intervention by 40%
Specified billing center automation requirements covering premium calculation, invoice generation, payment processing, and delinquency management workflows
Documented multi-level underwriting approval workflows with automated routing rules based on policy amount, risk score, transaction type, and business rules engine configuration
Performed AS-IS/TO-BE gap analysis identifying $11M ROI opportunity through intelligent workflow optimization and process reengineering across insurance operations
Capital Markets / Investment Banking
Gathered and documented business requirements for Investment Banking and Capital Markets applications supporting Office operations.
Analyzed the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture, execution, allocation, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation.
Collaborated with traders, portfolio managers, operations, risk, finance, and compliance teams to translate business needs into functional requirements.
Created BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and RTMs for Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Derivatives trading platforms.
Defined Target Operating Models (TOMs) for Investment Banking and Capital Markets processes by assessing current operating structures, identifying process, people, data and technology gaps, and designing future-state operating models aligned with business objectives.
Developed business capability maps across Trade Processing, Settlement, Reconciliation, Risk, Finance and Operations to identify capability gaps, ownership dependencies and opportunities for process transformation.
Created end-to-end customer/user journey maps for banking and investment workflows, mapping key touchpoints, business interactions, hand-offs, pain points and exception scenarios to identify opportunities for improved service delivery and operational efficiency.
Supported UAT by preparing test scenarios, validating trade workflows, coordinating defect resolution, and obtaining business sign-off.
Worked with regulatory teams to align solutions with Basel III, AML/KYC requirements.
Documented business rules for trade validation, exception handling, corporate actions, and securities settlement.
Worked on portfolio management, position management, cash reconciliation, P&L reporting, and exposure monitoring requirements.
Banking, Payments & SWIFT Integration
Gathered and documented business requirements for payment gateway integrations including SWIFT MT/MX messaging standards, payment authorization flows, and settlement processing pipelines
Defined functional specifications for cross-border payment workflows covering SWIFT MT103 (customer transfers), MT202 (bank transfers), MT940/950 (account statement/balance reporting), and ISO 20022 MX message formats
Documented Nostro/Vostro account reconciliation processes, correspondent banking workflows, and automated matching rules for payment exception handling and dispute resolution
Specified integration requirements between policy administration/claims platforms and payment gateways, banking APIs, and settlement systems for premium collection and claims disbursement
Collaborated with development and integration teams to define API contracts for payment gateway connectivity, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS, banking regulations, and SWIFT network standards
Designed Target Operating Models for cross-border payment processes, defining future-state processes, roles and responsibilities, operational controls, system interactions and governance across payment initiation, processing, settlement and reconciliation.
Mapped end-to-end payment customer journeys covering payment initiation, beneficiary validation, authorization, screening, routing, processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception/repair handling, identifying customer and operational pain points.
Developed business capability maps for Payments, covering payment initiation, payment processing, sanctions/compliance, clearing & settlement, reconciliation, investigation and reporting capabilities, and assessed gaps between current and target-state capabilities.
Performed TOM and capability gap assessments to identify opportunities for payment process standardization, automation, straight-through processing and improved operational controls.
AI, Automation & Digital Transformation
Defined requirements for ML-powered intelligent routing engine: predictive claim routing, fraud detection patterns, automated underwriting decisioning, and payment anomaly detection capabilities
Specified acceptance criteria for AI/ML models including accuracy thresholds, performance benchmarks, data governance requirements, and regulatory explainability standards
Supported CRM workflow improvements via Zendesk: ticket routing automation, SLA tracking configuration, and integration specifications with insurance/banking platforms
Stakeholder Management & Agile Delivery
Served as primary liaison across business stakeholders, product owners, dev teams, QA, and C-level executives; facilitated JAD sessions, design reviews, UAT, and sprint ceremonies
Managed 100+ user story backlog aligned to business objectives; achieved 95%+ sprint commitment accuracy through refined estimation, capacity planning, and story clarity
Reduced sprint spillover by 30% and improved velocity by 18% within first quarter through impediment removal, workflow optimization, and requirement standardization
Delivered 5 major releases with 98% pre-production defect identification rate; accelerated time-to-market by 3 weeks through zero-rework requirements delivery

targets.text: JITENDRA SAGAR
SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST
P&C Insurance  |  Banking & Payments (SWIFT/ISO 20022) | BFSI
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of progressive experience across P&C Insurance, Banking & Payments, and Finance & Treasury domains. Deep expertise in SWIFT messaging standards (MT103, MT202, MT940, MT950, MX/ISO 20022), Vostro & Nostro account management, correspondent banking, payment lifecycle management, and treasury operations. Proven track record in P&C Insurance (Policy Administration, Claims Management, Billing, Underwriting), digital transformation, and AI-powered workflow automation. Strong experience in requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, Agile/Scrum delivery, stakeholder management, and UAT execution. Adept at translating complex business processes into precise technical specifications that deliver measurable ROI. Familiar with core banking platforms (Finacle, T24/Temenos, FIS), insurance policy systems, and CRM platforms (Zendesk). Certified SAFe Agilist (
in progress) and CBAP (pursuing).

Key Domains: P&C Insurance (Policy, Claims, Billing, Underwriting)  •  SWIFT/MT/MX Payments  •  ISO 20022 / SEPA / RTGS  •  Nostro/Vostro/Correspondent Banking  •  Treasury & Cash Management  •  Trade Finance  •  HRMS  •  E-Commerce

Data & Analytics: SQL, Power BI, Excel
Insurance Systems: Policy Administration Systems, Claims Management Platforms, Billing Systems
Collaboration: Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Zendesk (CRM)
Finance & ERP: SAP (Basic), Oracle Financials (Basic), Treasury Management Systems (TMS)
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner
EA Team (Client – Standard Chartered ( US ) 					January 2024 – Present

Leading business analysis, Target Operating Model (TOM) design and requirements engineering across banking, payments and insurance transformation initiatives, defining current-state processes, future-state operating models, business capabilities and transformation opportunities across cross-functional teams.
P&C Insurance – Policy, Claims, Billing & Underwriting

Elicited and documented end-to-end insurance business requirements across policy lifecycle: new business, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements, maintaining 100% requirement traceability via RTM
Defined functional requirements for automated claims workflows: FNOL intake, claim assignment, investigation, adjudication, settlement, and payment disbursement, reducing manual intervention by 40%
Specified billing center automation requirements covering premium calculation, invoice generation, payment processing, and delinquency management workflows
Documented multi-level underwriting approval workflows with automated routing rules based on policy amount, risk score, transaction type, and business rules engine configuration
Performed AS-IS/TO-BE gap analysis identifying $11M ROI opportunity through intelligent workflow optimization and process reengineering across insurance operations
Capital Markets / Investment Banking
Gathered and documented business requirements for Investment Banking and Capital Markets applications supporting Office operations.
Analyzed the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture, execution, allocation, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation.
Collaborated with traders, portfolio managers, operations, risk, finance, and compliance teams to translate business needs into functional requirements.
Created BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and RTMs for Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Derivatives trading platforms.

Defined Target Operating Models (TOMs) for Investment Banking and Capital Markets processes by assessing current operating structures, identifying process, people, data and technology gaps, and designing future-state operating models aligned with business objectives.

Developed business capability maps across Trade Processing, Settlement, Reconciliation, Risk, Finance and Operations to identify capability gaps, ownership dependencies and opportunities for process transformation.

Created end-to-end customer/user journey maps for banking and investment workflows, mapping key touchpoints, business interactions, hand-offs, pain points and exception scenarios to identify opportunities for improved service delivery and operational efficiency.
Supported UAT by preparing test scenarios, validating trade workflows, coordinating defect resolution, and obtaining business sign-off.
Worked with regulatory teams to align solutions with Basel III, AML/KYC requirements.
Documented business rules for trade validation, exception handling, corporate actions, and securities settlement.
Worked on portfolio management, position management, cash reconciliation, P&L reporting, and exposure monitoring requirements.
Banking, Payments & SWIFT Integration
Gathered and documented business requirements for payment gateway integrations including SWIFT MT/MX messaging standards, payment authorization flows, and settlement processing pipelines

Defined functional specifications for cross-border payment workflows covering SWIFT MT103 (customer transfers), MT202 (bank transfers), MT940/950 (account statement/balance reporting), and ISO 20022 MX message formats
Documented Nostro/Vostro account reconciliation processes, correspondent banking workflows, and automated matching rules for payment exception handling and dispute resolution
Specified integration requirements between policy administration/claims platforms and payment gateways, banking APIs, and settlement systems for premium collection and claims disbursement
Collaborated with development and integration teams to define API contracts for payment gateway connectivity, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS, banking regulations, and SWIFT network standards

Designed Target Operating Models for cross-border payment processes, defining future-state processes, roles and responsibilities, operational controls, system interactions and governance across payment initiation, processing, settlement and reconciliation.

Mapped end-to-end payment customer journeys covering payment initiation, beneficiary validation, authorization, screening, routing, processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception/repair handling, identifying customer and operational pain points.

Developed business capability maps for Payments, covering payment initiation, payment processing, sanctions/compliance, clearing & settlement, reconciliation, investigation and reporting capabilities, and assessed gaps between current and target-state capabilities.
Performed TOM and capability gap assessments to identify opportunities for payment process standardization, automation, straight-through processing and improved operational controls.
AI, Automation & Digital Transformation
Defined requirements for ML-powered intelligent routing engine: predictive claim routing, fraud detection patterns, automated underwriting decisioning, and payment anomaly detection capabilities
Specified acceptance criteria for AI/ML models including accuracy thresholds, performance benchmarks, data governance requirements, and regulatory explainability standards
Supported CRM workflow improvements via Zendesk: ticket routing automation, SLA tracking configuration, and integration specifications with insurance/banking platforms
Stakeholder Management & Agile Delivery
Served as primary liaison across business stakeholders, product owners, dev teams, QA, and C-level executives; facilitated JAD sessions, design reviews, UAT, and sprint ceremonies
Managed 100+ user story backlog aligned to business objectives; achieved 95%+ sprint commitment accuracy through refined estimation, capacity planning, and story clarity
Reduced sprint spillover by 30% and improved velocity by 18% within first quarter through impediment removal, workflow optimization, and requirement standardization
Delivered 5 major releases with 98% pre-production defect identification rate; accelerated time-to-market by 3 weeks through zero-rework requirements delivery
Senior Business Analyst | IDC Technology (Clients – Allstate, Global Alliance Corporation (GAL))
May 2021 – December 2023
Led business analysis and Agile delivery for insurance, banking, and enterprise application product development teams across multiple concurrent Scrum teams.
Insurance Domain Analysis

Analyzed and documented complex P&C insurance business processes across policy management, commercial lines underwriting, billing operations, and claims workflows; delivered 22% improvement in operational efficiency
Performed SWOT analysis, cost-benefit analysis, and risk assessments to evaluate solution alternatives for insurance process automation and digital transformation initiatives
Created comprehensive AS-IS/TO-BE documentation, swimlane diagrams, data flow diagrams, and ERDs for policy, billing, and claims systems; maintained RTM ensuring full bidirectional traceability
Banking, Payments & Financial Domain
Gathered and documented requirements for payment processing workflows: transaction validation, authorization, payment reconciliation, settlement, and end-of-day reporting processes
Defined business rules for SWIFT-based payment flows, wire transfer processing, and exception handling scenarios for cross-border and domestic payment operations
Developed detailed specifications for banking transaction workflows including payment status tracking, reconciliation gap analysis, and operational KPI dashboards using Power BI and Excel
Documented integration requirements for CRM platforms (Zendesk) with banking/payment systems to support customer payment inquiries, dispute handling, and transaction status tracking
Collaborated with technology teams on API integration specifications for payment gateways, banking systems, and third-party financial data providers ensuring data accuracy and compliance
Agile Delivery & Team Leadership
Facilitated Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions across 3 concurrent Scrum teams
Increased team velocity by 22% over 6 months through process optimization, requirement clarity, and Agile coaching (Planning Poker, T-Shirt Sizing, capacity planning)
Successfully transitioned 2 teams from Waterfall to Agile methodology with zero disruption to delivery; delivered 8 major product releases on schedule and within budget
Achieved 90%+ stakeholder satisfaction scores through proactive communication, timely delivery, and high-quality documentation standards

targets.text: Business Analyst | IDC Technology	August 2020 – April 2021
Drove requirements engineering and business analysis for insurance and HRMS product development initiatives, delivering high-quality documentation with zero post-development change requests.

Business Analyst | IDC Technology	July 2019 – July 2020
Supported BFSI domain requirements across payment processing, transaction workflows, and insurance operations.

Analyzed financial transaction data to identify payment failures, reconciliation gaps, and process improvement opportunities; reduced documentation rework by 20%
Delivered requirements for 3 major product releases on schedule; translated business needs into user stories with precise acceptance criteria for Agile development teams
Associate Business Analyst | IDC Technology	July 2018 – May 2019
Assisted senior BAs in requirements gathering, documentation, validation, UAT coordination, and defect management for insurance and BFSI product development projects
Prepared process maps, user flows, wireframes, and supporting documentation; reduced documentation cycle time by 20% through template standardization
Conducted industry and competitive research to support decision-making; recognized for attention to detail, analytical skills, and proactive stakeholder communication
Project Coordinator | IDC Technology	April 2017 – July 2018
Coordinated schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocation across development, QA, and operations for 5+ concurrent projects ensuring on-time delivery
